title: Remove invalid CSS cross-import in fields package
body:
Build failed when the fields package attempted to import `@object-ui/components/style.css`. During Vite build, the import resolved to the non-existent source path `/packages/components/src/style.css` instead of the published export.

## Changes

- Removed `packages/fields/src/index.css` containing `@import '@object-ui/components/style.css'`
- Removed CSS import from `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`

Library packages should not cross-import CSS - consuming applications import styles directly via published package exports. This aligns with patterns used elsewhere in the monorepo (components, runner, etc.).
